title: Multistrada V4 Rally
description: Engineered for riders seeking confident performance and refined dynamics, the Ducati Multistrada V4 Rally is purpose-built to crush coast-to-coast highway miles and conquer rugged backcountry tracks. Its tuned powertrain delivers immediate, tractable torque against a curb weight of 110 kg, ensuring responsive roll-on acceleration in demanding road conditions. Riders are greeted by an ergonomic Aggressive Forward Tuck posture paired with a commanding 855mm perch delivering excellent ground clearance and expansive sightlines, backed by a 5.5L fuel tank for extended saddle stints.
